30 Description: In 2024, around 89 percent of online shoppers said that one of the most important criteria for them when shopping online was an easy payment process. For 72 percent, customer service carried a lot of weight. Read more

forecast_users.text:
Description: In 2023, 69 percent of the female population in Switzerland shopped online. This was a decrease compared to 2021, when the figure stood at 80 percent. The development is perhaps due to the increased levels of online shopping that took place during
the pandemic. Read more
Note(s): Switzerland; 2010 to 2023; 15 years and older; People who shopped online in the last 12 months
Source(s): Bundesamt für Statistik (Schweiz)
